source_title: A Mathematical Model for Real Time Flight Simulation of a Generic Tilt Rotor Aircraft
source_report: NASA CR-166536; STI TR-1195-2, September 1988 Rev. A (Final)
source_identity: Appendix B: XV-15 Wing-Pylon Aerodynamics; source-model data tables, not new experimental measurements
read_method: Each printed numeric cell read visually from Poppler PNG render; PDF has no searchable text layer. No OCR values copied without image inspection.
numeric_conversion: None. Original decimal values retained; leading zeros normalized. No interpolation, fitting, SI conversion, unit rescaling, or invented grid nodes.

not_defined_policy.policy: No printed numeric cell in these eight tables is blank or labelled Not Defined. Unprovided configurations are NOT_DEFINED conceptually, never zero; no extra CSV cells are synthesized.
specific_unprovided_regions: 4-IX/4-X Mach subtable supplies only X_FL1 and beta_m=90. Other flap/mast combinations at those Mach nodes are not supplied.
4-XI alpha_W < -8 deg extension is not prescribed; the table caption domain is abs(alpha_W) <= 8 deg, while the footnote explicitly covers 8 < alpha_W <= 25 deg and alpha_W > 25 deg.

4-XI equality endpoints are confirmed from the scan: abs(alpha_W) <= 8 deg table domain; 8 < alpha_W <= 25 deg interpolation; alpha_W > 25 deg K_l_delta_a=0.0. Negative alpha_W < -8 deg remains unspecified.

beta_m.name: mast angle
beta_m.basis: B-34/PDF384 explicitly labels both modes. This is opposite to some domestic nacelle-angle conventions; no conversion was applied.

M_N.name: Mach number
M_N.warning: Low-Mach interval header is not collapsed to one sampled Mach number.

flap_setting.warning: Slash separates the source paired setting, not a numerical ratio. The pair order is not restated in Tables 4-IX to 4-XVI; retain literal labels until the control mapping is checked.

alpha_WFS.name: wing freestream angle of attack
alpha_WFS.basis: A70/PDF138 B.3 uses the 57.3 radians-to-degrees factor. Table 4-IX uses C_LWPFS slope at C_LWP=0.

alpha_bar_PYL.name: spinner/pylon incidence in mast axes
alpha_bar_PYL.warning: Not interchangeable with body sideslip beta_F or alpha_PLAT used for body-axis transformation.

delta_a.name: aileron deflection
delta_a.basis: B32/PDF382 gives C_l_delta_a baseline in 1/deg; B54/PDF404 gives C_L_delta_a in 1/deg.

force_moment_reference.lift_drag: local wind-axis lift/drag; q_WFS*S_WFS normalizes free-stream wing load before aileron decrement (A70)
force_moment_reference.pylon_interference: D_PYINT multiplies mean left/right immersed-wing dynamic pressure only (A75)
force_moment_reference.sideslip_pylon_drag: 2*q_PLAT*S_PLAT*K_PLAT; S_PLAT is one-nacelle projected lateral flat-plate area (A77)

reference_constants_context_only.source: B31/PDF381. Already present in batch6, not duplicated as new table cells.

formulas_and_constants_transcribed.note: Source does not identify a new pair of interpolation nodes here; do not invent C_L1, C_L2, alpha_1 or alpha_2.
The alpha_W term in the first printed formula is interpreted using the immediately following alpha_W_at_CL0 definition; no numerical values computed.

formulas_and_constants_transcribed.formula: For 8 < alpha_W <= 25 deg, interpolate a straight line between tabulated K and zero; for alpha_W > 25 deg, K_l_delta_a=0.0; straight-line variation with mast angle.
formulas_and_constants_transcribed.caption: for abs(alpha_W) <= 8 deg
formulas_and_constants_transcribed.note: Equality endpoints are confirmed from the 360 dpi scan. The positive-alpha interpolation/zero rule is explicit; alpha_W < -8 deg extension is not supplied and must be rejected.
Last factor is lowercase-l rolling-moment derivative, not uppercase-L lift derivative.

unit_decisions.4-IX: No table unit printed; 1/deg resolved from B51 slope formula and A70 degree-valued alpha_WFS. Values not multiplied by 57.3.
unit_decisions.4-X: No table unit printed; dimensionless from D_WP=q_WFS*S_WFS*C_DWPFS in A70.
unit_decisions.4-XI: No table unit printed; dimensionless multiplicative correction in A73.
unit_decisions.4-XII: 1/deg explicitly printed in B54 table header.
unit_decisions.4-XIII: No table unit printed; 1/deg resolved from A71/A74 yaw derivative equation and B32 C_l_delta_a=0.006 1/deg.
unit_decisions.4-XIV: No table unit printed; dimensionless multiplier in B54/A74.
unit_decisions.4-XV: Title says Drag Coefficient but no table unit printed. A75 defines D_PYLN=D_PYINT*q_mean, so D_PYINT has area units ft^2; no S_W normalization.
unit_decisions.4-XVI: No table unit printed; dimensionless in A77 D_PLAT=2*q_PLAT*S_PLAT*K_PLAT.

related_unit_audit_requested_by_parent.evidence: A43/PDF111 explicitly lists l_beta in ft^3; A44/PDF112 C gives l_prime_F=q_F*l_beta. Existing batch5 file was not edited.
A70/PDF138 B.4: M_prime_WP=q_WFS*S_W*c_W*C_mWP. A71/PDF139 says C_mWP=f(beta_m,delta_F), chosen at C_LWP approximately zero. Existing table values and files were not changed; do not multiply by 57.3.

verification.scope: data transcription only; no model, manifest, or check-script changes; no git commit
verification.independent_second_reader: Parent root agent independently re-rendered 360 dpi and confirmed <= endpoints on PDF403.
